name: Sprigatito & Meowscarada ex Starter Set ex

releases.name: Sprigatito & Meowscarada ex Starter Set ex

description.text: Starter Set ex Sprigatito & Meowscarada ex, released on 31 July 2026 with Eevee ex's and Zorua & Zoroark ex's: a ready-to-play 60-card deck of Grass Pokémon, with two Meowscarada ex and a full-illustration Sprigatito. Meowscarada ex's attack does 120 damage, and 120 more to one of the opponent's Benched Pokémon that already has damage counters on it. Once a turn, Arboliva's Ability switches the opponent's Active Pokémon with one on their Bench, and Shaymin and Virizion join them. Damage counters and markers of paper, a coin and a playmat of its own, a player's guide and a how-to-play booklet came with it, and some of its cards are reprints from earlier series.
